title: USAA UX Audit
jpTitle: USAA モバイル定期生命保険 UX 監査

summary.en: Audited USAA's mobile term-life-insurance app by combining Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics with trauma-informed design principles — safety, respect, community, dignity — on the premise that insurance decisions are emotionally loaded and standard heuristics alone couldn't explain high abandonment among qualified leads.
summary.jp: USAA の定期生命保険アプリを監査した。Nielsen の 10 原則に、安全・敬意・共感・尊厳という配慮の視点を重ねた。保険は感情が重く、通常の評価だけでは離脱理由が見えなかった。

product.en: A UX audit that added a second lens most heuristic reviews skip: alongside Nielsen's 10 heuristics, a trauma-informed layer (safety, respect, community, dignity) surfaced why qualified leads were abandoning an insurance application that a usability review alone couldn't explain.
product.jp: 普通の使い勝手評価に、もう 1 つの視点を足した。Nielsen の 10 原則に、安全・敬意・共感・尊厳という配慮の層を重ねた。資格ある見込み客がなぜ離脱するかを説明した。

mine: Combined Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics with trauma-informed design principles (safety, respect, community, dignity)
Used the usability layer to identify structural friction — navigation, cognitive load, error recovery
Used the trauma-informed layer to identify emotional friction — clinical language, anxiety-amplifying progress indicators, decision points lacking emotional scaffolding
Rated issues by severity: 6 critical, 7 major, 3 minor, 1 irritant
Built an effort-vs-value matrix prioritizing UX, UI and trauma-informed fixes
team: Senior UX Designer, UI Designer, Tech Lead and Project Manager — credited on the page by role title, without individual task breakdown separate from Takao's lead role

narrative.problem: Insurance is inherently tied to trauma — death, loss, the fear of leaving a family unprotected — and the interface showed no awareness of this. Standard heuristics caught navigation and form issues but couldn't explain why qualified leads were abandoning the application at such high rates.

_notes: The page does not explicitly label the 40%/30%/25% figures as projected vs. measured; since the only deliverables listed are an evaluation report and a roadmap (not a shipped redesign), these are recorded with confidence 'unverified' as projected/recommended improvements rather than measured outcomes.
Engagement type not explicitly stated on the page.

cardLine.en: Insurance decisions are emotional, so the audit weighed dignity alongside heuristics.
cardLine.jp: 保険の判断は感情的だから、使いやすさだけでなく尊厳も測った監査。
